title: Dotfiles Profile Configuration
description: Configuration schema for dotfiles profile config.yml files

additional_dotfiles_dirs.description: List of extra dotfiles directories from custom inventories

agent_folders.description: List of destination directories for agents (e.g., ~/.claude/agents)

agent_instructions_destinations.description: List of destination files to write assembled instructions to. Each entry has a path and optional frontmatter (for .mdc format).

bin_dir.description: Path to profile's bin scripts directory

brew_packages.description: List of Homebrew formulas to install

brew_taps.description: List of Homebrew taps to configure

state.description: Whether the tap should be present or absent

brew_upgrade_all.description: Whether to run brew upgrade after installation

cask_packages.description: List of Homebrew casks to install

claude_plugin_marketplaces.description: List of custom marketplaces to register

claude_plugins.description: List of Claude Code plugins to install

marketplace.description: Marketplace to install from (defaults to claude-plugins-official)

composer_packages.description: List of composer packages to install

dotfiles_cleanup_depth.description: Maximum depth for recursive dead symlink cleanup

dotfiles_copy_dir.description: Path to profile's dotfiles-copy directory (files copied instead of symlinked)

dotfiles_directory_marker.description: Marker file for directory-level symlinks. Directories containing this file will be symlinked as directories instead of recursively symlinking files.

dotfiles_symlink_command.description: Command to run symlink-dotfiles (installed from packages/symlink_dotfiles via uv)

gem_packages.description: List of Ruby gems to install

gh_extensions.description: List of GitHub CLI extensions to install

gh_repos.description: List of GitHub repositories to clone

tag.description: Tag to checkout (takes precedence over branch)

git_hooks.description: Git hook snippets contributed by this profile, materialized into a per-hook-name dispatcher script in git_hooks_dir. Entries for the same hook name from multiple profiles concatenate in (order, priority) order, they do not overwrite each other. Not read by this role directly — collected from every profile's hostvars, see collect_profile_fragments.yml.

hook.description: Git hook name, or a list of hook names, from git_hooks_all_names — one entry applying to several hook names is common (e.g. the same husky/pre-commit chaining snippet across every commit lifecycle hook), so a list is accepted here instead of forcing a separate git_hooks entry per name.

order.description: Explicit sequencing among snippets for the same hook name, independent of which profile declared them. Lower runs first; ties fall back to profile priority.

scope.description: "global": pure shell over git's own hook inputs only (e.g. the commit message file path) — runs unconditionally in every repo. "trusted": runs only when the repo's remote URL(s) match git_hooks_trusted_remotes, checked at hook runtime via normalized shell glob matching, not includeIf.

script.description: Shell snippet body, inlined verbatim into the generated dispatcher.

git_hooks_all_names.description: Fixed list of client-side git hook names materialized as dispatchers whenever git_hooks is in use, independent of which names any profile actually declares a git_hooks entry for — so chaining to a pre-existing repo-local hook (see the gitconfig role README) keeps working for every hook type, not just customized ones. Deliberately excludes reference-transaction and post-index-change (fire far too often per operation for the per-invocation trust-check overhead to be worth it) and fsmonitor-watchman (not a lifecycle hook — git queries it for a protocol response, there's nothing to dispatch). Override this var in a profile's config.yml if you genuinely need one of those.

git_hooks_dir.description: Directory that becomes core.hooksPath and holds the generated per-hook-name dispatcher scripts, once at least one profile declares a git_hooks entry.

git_hooks_gitconfig_file.description: Generated gitconfig fragment that sets core.hooksPath to git_hooks_dir. Only written when at least one profile declares a git_hooks entry; removed (and core.hooksPath left unset) otherwise. Always referenced via an unconditional [include] in the shell profile's gitconfig fragment, which git silently skips while this file doesn't exist.

git_hooks_precommit_types.description: Hook names pre-commit's `hook-impl` subcommand actually supports. The pre-commit invocation is only ever rendered for these; other hook names never get an automatic pre-commit tail, though user-authored trusted-scope snippets can still target them.

git_hooks_precommit_uvx_spec.description: Package spec passed to `uvx` when pre-commit isn't found on PATH.

git_hooks_trusted_remotes.description: Glob patterns matched against this machine's repo remote URLs, after both sides are normalized to a scheme-less host/path form (so one pattern matches a repo whether it was cloned over ssh or https). Entries from all profiles are unioned. A repo is trusted if ANY configured remote matches ANY pattern; a repo with no remotes is untrusted. Gates scope: trusted git_hooks entries and the pre-commit hook-impl invocation. Not read by this role directly — collected from every profile's hostvars.

gitconfig_conf_d.description: Path to the git conf.d directory for config fragments

gitconfig_includes_file.description: Path to the generated includes.gitconfig file

gitignore_file.description: Path to the global gitignore file

json_configs.description: List of JSON configuration items to apply

content.description: Dictionary of settings to merge into the file

create_file.description: Create the file if it does not exist

mas_packages.description: List of Mac App Store packages to install

mas_upgrade_all.description: Whether to upgrade all Mac App Store packages

mcp_default_config_files.description: Default config files to update when config_files is not specified per server

mcp_force_post_clone.description: Force re-run of post_clone commands for all git-based servers, even if the marker file exists and the repo has not changed. Useful for retrying failed builds. Pass via --extra-vars.

mcp_run_with_secrets_bin.description: Absolute path to the `run-with-secrets.sh` wrapper used when a server specifies `secret_env`. The role writes this path into the rendered MCP config as the server's command, with VAR=key.path pairs and the real command placed after `--`.

mcp_servers.description:
List of MCP server configurations.
Each server must have a name and either a command or url.

_profile.description: Profile name that contributed this server (injected by playbook aggregation)

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command

auth.description: Authentication block passed through to mcp-hub for keychain-managed secrets. mcp-hub injects the resolved values at server spawn time instead of storing them in the config file.

command.description: Command to run the server (stdio transport)

config_files.description: List of config files to update for this server

optional.description: If true, silently skip this path when its parent directory does not exist (useful for paths that depend on other tools being installed — e.g. Claude Desktop, a cloned sibling repo). When false (the default), the role creates the parent directory if missing and writes the config file.

state.description: Whether to add or remove the server from this config file

description.description: Short human-readable description of what the server does. Surfaced by mcp-hub in list_servers/search for discovery.

git_dest.description: Destination path for the cloned repository

git_force.description: Force git clone/checkout even if destination exists

git_force_reset.description: Allow destructive operations when local changes (uncommitted/unpushed) exist in the repo

git_repo.description: Git repository URL to clone for the server

git_subfolder.description: Subdirectory within the git repo for post_clone commands. Used for monorepo support where multiple servers share the same git_dest.

git_version.description: Git version (branch, tag, or commit) to checkout

headers.description: HTTP headers for URL-based servers (supports vault and 1Password secrets)

post_clone.description: Shell command to run after cloning the repository

secret_env.description: Environment variables whose values are resolved at server spawn time by the `run-with-secrets.sh` wrapper (via `dotfiles secret get`). Values in this dict are vault key paths (dot-notation), never the secrets themselves — so the rendered MCP config stays commit-safe. The role rewrites `command`/`args` to invoke the wrapper; plain `env` still ships as-is alongside. Stdio servers only.

secret_headers.description: HTTP header name mapped to a sops key-path (dot notation, optional at-profile suffix) resolved into `headers` at install time via the vault_secret lookup. A simpler, validated alternative to writing a lookup('vault_secret', ...) expression by hand in `headers`. URL-based servers only. A header name must not appear in both `headers` and `secret_headers`.

state.description: Whether the server should be present or absent

tags.description: Optional list of tags for grouping/filtering servers. Surfaced by mcp-hub in list_servers/search; useful for filtering by scope (adobe, personal), domain (docs, observability), or tool.

transport.description: Transport type for URL-based servers (e.g., sse, streamable-http)

type.description: Server type (e.g., http) included in config output

url.description: HTTP endpoint URL for the MCP server (HTTP/SSE transport)

mcp_servers_git_base.description: Base directory for git-cloned MCP servers

npm_packages.description: List of npm packages to install globally

pip_packages.description: List of pip packages to install

pipx_packages.description:
List of pipx packages to install.
Simple string entries install from PyPI.
Dict entries support additional options.

build_deps.description: List of Homebrew packages whose prefixes will be used to set CFLAGS (-I) and LDFLAGS (-L) during installation

editable.description: Install in editable mode (default true for local packages)

git.description: Git URL to install from (e.g. git+https://github.com/user/repo.git). Uses `uv tool install --from <git> <name>` when uv is available, falls back to `pipx install <git>`. Mutually exclusive with `path`.

path.description: Local package path. Paths starting with "packages/" are relative to the profile directory.

profile.description: Profile configuration for the dynamic inventory plugin

host.description: Ansible host name (defaults to profile name)

skill_folders.description: List of destination directories for skills (e.g., ~/.claude/skills)

other_options.description: Additional SSH options as key-value pairs

yaml_configs.description: List of YAML configuration items to apply

content.description: Dictionary of settings to merge into the file

create_file.description: Create the file if it does not exist
